name: zinput_create_constant_force_effect_with_direction
description: zInput_DI_CreateConstantForceEffectWithDirection builds an infinite-duration two-axis DirectInput constant-force effect with a fixed magnitude and caller-supplied initial polar direction.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; final byte matching should be handled in the zInput DirectInput/force-feedback source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x430070 validates the caller-supplied direction in the first polar direction slot, second direction zero, axes {0, 4}, DICONSTANTFORCE magnitude 10000, DIEFFECT size 0x34, flags 0x22, infinite duration, trigger button -1, zero gain, type-specific byte count 4, and delegation to zInput_DI_CreateForceFeedbackEffect with GUID_ConstantForce.
The native smoke verifies descriptor fields for a directed constant-force effect, including direction value, infinite duration, zero gain, two axes, and type-specific magnitude.
